description: Shows programs that are running right now. Each running program is called a process and has a number called a PID.
tip: Start with plain ps. Add aux later when you want a full list.

description: A live dashboard of running processes. It updates until you press q to quit.
Asks a running process to stop. You pass the PID you saw in ps or top.
tip: Try a normal kill first. -9 is a last resort.
